title: Equal circles and balls packed in a container with the largest radius

template.title: {n} equal circles or balls in the container of Packomania section {section}
template.statement: Place {n} non-overlapping circles (balls) of equal radius in the container of section {section} so that the radius is as large as possible.
template.submission: Text file: the radius on the first line, then {n} lines with the coordinates of the centres (decimal numbers separated by spaces or commas), in the frame given by checkers/pack_check.py for section {section}.

best_text: The best known radius in Packomania's table is {best} ({holder}); a valid packing with a larger radius improves it.
open_rule: every N of the sections csq, cci, csc, ccq, crt, scu, ssp, hsp4, hsp5, hsp6 and of the eight 1 x h rectangles crc100 to crc800 whose radius is not in bold (proven optimal); for the rectangles also not N <= 2 and not a radius of h/2, which no circle can exceed
left_out: csq: 30 proven, 0 small N; cci: 13 proven, 0 small N; csc: 0 proven, 3 small N; ccq: 0 proven, 2 small N; crt: 0 proven, 2 small N, 2 N listed twice (the better value kept); scu: 0 proven, 9 small N; ssp: 0 proven, 11 small N; hsp4: 0 proven, 5 small N, 1 N listed twice (the better value kept); hsp5: 0 proven, 5 small N; hsp6: 0 proven, 6 small N; crc100: 10 proven, 0 small N, 1 N listed twice (the better value kept); crc200: 5 proven, 0 small N; crc300: 3 proven, 0 small N; crc400: 2 proven, 0 small N; crc500: 2 proven, 0 small N; crc600: 0 proven, 2 small N; crc700: 1 proven, 1 small N; crc800: 1 proven, 1 small N; the regular-polygon sections and the sections with irrational radii (exact checks need algebraic numbers); the rectangle of variable aspect ratio (crc_var)
